name: tilt-card
summary: A card that leans toward your finger in 3D while a glare slides across it.
props: Content (sets the card's size). Wrap parts in <TiltLayer depth> to float them.
Photo that fills the card behind the content.
Darkens the bottom of the photo so white text stays readable (0–1).
Tilt in degrees at the card's edge.
Light reflection that follows your finger. "holo" adds a rainbow foil sheen that shifts as the card leans.
Where the reflection may fall (card points) — for cards with cut-outs, so light never shows over a hole.
Depth of the effect — smaller is more dramatic.
Soft shadow under the card that shifts as it tilts.
Fires on a tap (not after a drag).
How far a layer floats above the card (negative sinks below).
A holographic foil patch (seal, sticker, strip) whose rainbow shifts as the card leans.
() => { tx, ty, press, width, height } | null
The card's live tilt values (native-driver friendly) for your own effects.
behavior: Press and drag to tilt up to maxTilt degrees; the card scales by pressScale and springs flat on release. onPress fires on a tap, not after a drag.
The shadow slides away from the light and the glare (soft, sharp or holo) glides across. TiltLayer children float at their own depth, and idle makes it sway gently at rest.
Exposed as one element when it has onPress or accessibilityLabel; with onPress it is a button with an 'activate' action.
usage:
import { TiltCard, TiltLayer } from '@/components/ui/tilt-card';

<TiltCard image={{ uri: photoUrl }} idle accessibilityLabel="Manarola, Cinque Terre" style={{ width: 270, height: 360 }}>
  <TiltLayer depth={1}>
    <PlaceCaption place={place} />
  </TiltLayer>
</TiltCard>

examples.code:
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Image, Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { TiltCard, TiltLayer } from '@/components/ui/tilt-card';
import { alpha, useKit } from '@/lib/kit';

/** Any photo works (`require()` or a URL). `blur` gives soft, abstract art. */
const photo = (id: number, w: number, h: number, blur = false) => ({ uri: `https://picsum.photos/id/${id}/${w}/${h}${blur ? '?blur=10' : ''}` });

export default function NowPlaying() {
  const { colors } = useKit();
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(true);
  return (
    <View style={{ alignItems: 'center', gap: 18 }}>
      <View style={{ alignSelf: 'stretch', flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 6 }}>
        <Text style={{ color: colors.foreground, fontSize: 20 }}>⌄</Text>
        <View style={{ alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <Text style={{ color: colors.mutedForeground, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: '700', letterSpacing: 1 }}>PLAYING FROM</Text>
          <Text style={{ color: colors.foreground, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '600' }}>Late night drive</Text>
        </View>
        <Text style={{ color: colors.foreground, fontSize: 20 }}>⋯</Text>
      </View>
      <TiltCard idle image={photo(888, 300, 300, true)} shade={0.35} radius={20} accessibilityLabel="Midnight Bloom by Lumen" style={{ width: 250 }}>
        <View style={{ height: 250 }} />
        <TiltLayer depth={1}>
          <View style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 18, bottom: 16 }}>
            <Text style={{ color: '#fff', fontSize: 30, fontWeight: '900', letterSpacing: -1, lineHeight: 30 }}>MIDNIGHT</Text>
            <Text style={{ color: '#fff', fontSize: 30, fontWeight: '300', letterSpacing: -1, lineHeight: 32 }}>bloom</Text>
          </View>
        </TiltLayer>
      </TiltCard>
      <View style={{ alignSelf: 'stretch', gap: 10 }}>
        <View>
          <Text style={{ color: colors.foreground, fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '700' }}>Midnight Bloom</Text>
          <Text style={{ color: colors.mutedForeground, fontSize: 14 }}>Lumen</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={{ height: 4, borderRadius: 2, backgroundColor: alpha(colors.mutedForeground, 0.25) }}>
          <View style={{ width: '42%', height: 4, borderRadius: 2, backgroundColor: colors.foreground }} />
        </View>
        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginTop: -4 }}>
          <Text style={{ color: colors.mutedForeground, fontSize: 11, fontVariant: ['tabular-nums'] }}>1:42</Text>
          <Text style={{ color: colors.mutedForeground, fontSize: 11, fontVariant: ['tabular-nums'] }}>−2:21</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', gap: 34 }}>
          <Text style={{ color: colors.foreground, fontSize: 22 }}>⏮</Text>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => setPlaying((p) => !p)}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel={playing ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
            style={{ width: 58, height: 58, borderRadius: 29, backgroundColor: colors.foreground, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}
          >
            <Text style={{ color: colors.background, fontSize: 20 }}>{playing ? '❚❚' : '▶'}</Text>
          </Pressable>
          <Text style={{ color: colors.foreground, fontSize: 22 }}>⏭</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}
